`gen_delve factions` writes the two lists below into the plugin, PARALLEL by index: a site carrying keywordList[i] gets its waves from gangList[i]. A site carrying none of them (another mod's faction) keeps the template's own gang.
Another mod's faction is a new row here, never code. The gang lists are his own, from the classic missions.
